title: The Saju Café
description:
A saju (四柱) fortune-reading café in Hongdae.
"Give me your birth year, month, day, and time." The reader opens their laptop.

I think it's superstition. And yet I came.
No job, no investment gains — I just needed something to lean on.

choices.text: Ask for the full reading — money, career
choices.result_text:
'Your wealth direction is favorable this year — but you have to be ready to receive it.'

Fifty thousand won's worth of words. Somehow I felt lighter walking out.
Was it the saju working, or just deciding to believe because I'd already paid? Hard to tell.

choices.text: Listen politely, leave saying 'I'll keep it in mind'
choices.result_text:
'A big change could come within two years,' the reader said.

'Of course it could,' I thought — but my step was a little lighter walking out.
Sometimes you want to believe even when you know it might not be true.

title: Tarot
description:
A friend pulls up a tarot app.
"Draw your card for today." Half joking.

The Emperor card comes up.
Symbol of leadership, decisiveness, material success — so it says.

choices.text: Take it as a good sign — decide to believe it
choices.result_text:
Decided to believe it. No downside I could think of.

Became a kind of self-suggestion. I moved through the day a little more confidently than usual.
Whether the tarot was right or wrong mattered less than the way I showed up.

'The Emperor, huh.' I laughed and closed the app.

But why does it keep coming back to me. The Emperor.
Even when you try not to read meaning into things — people can't stop looking for patterns.

title: New Year's Fortune
description:
January — the portal homepage has a new-year fortune reading.
Free. Just enter your birth year.

I didn't mean to click it. My hand moved first.
I noticed I was hoping for something.

choices.result_text:
'This year is one of change. Act boldly and opportunity will find you.'

Always skewed positive, I know. I saved it anyway.
I think I understand a little why Koreans check this every January.

choices.text: Close the tab — I'll make my own fortune
choices.result_text:
Closed it.

Better to spend that time on one more action than reading fortune predictions, I thought.
Though honestly — part of it might have been that I was afraid to read it.
